assets.name: takase-expressions
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent 2x2 facial expression atlas for a Japanese mystery visual novel. One original fictional adult Japanese man aged around 40, a railway photography exhibition editor named Takase, refined hand-painted anime realism. Neatly swept short dark hair, narrow rectangular glasses, charcoal wool coat over a dark blue turtleneck, modest russet press lanyard, holding a thin dark document folder low at the waist. Distinctive but ordinary human, no villain costume. EXACTLY four equal square cells in a 2x2 grid, every cell shows the SAME character from top of hair to waist, consistent camera, consistent warm amber left rim light and cool teal shadows. Top-left: guarded neutral, mouth closed. Top-right: speaking with slightly open mouth, neutral eyes. Bottom-left: startled, brows tense, eyes slightly widened, mouth parted. Bottom-right: regretful calm, shoulders eased, small apologetic expression. Full head within each cell with 8% empty top margin, no head crop, no overlap between cells, no grid lines, absolutely no text. Isolated transparent background in every cell, not checkerboard. Premium detailed illustration, matching the atmosphere of a quiet rainy Japanese railway at midnight. Characters must be centered in their own cell, same scale and pose across all cells.
